# BIRD

BIRD is a local-first vector editor that runs entirely in the browser. It lets you
create illustrations, logos and layouts, then import and export them in the standard
vector formats (SVG, PDF, AI, EPS).

## Features

- Pen tool (Bezier curves) with anchor and handle editing
- Pencil and vector brushes (Line, Ink, Marker, Spray, Neon)
- Parametric shapes: rectangle (corner radius), ellipse, line, star, polygon
- Editable text (font, size, bold, italic, alignment)
- Vector Pathfinder (union, subtract, intersect, exclude)
- Layers panel: select, rename, visibility, locking, order
- Rulers, guides, grid and snapping
- Fill, stroke, dashes, opacity, blend modes
- Align, distribute, flip, zoom to selection
- Eyedropper and SVG/image clipboard
- Plug-ins: extensible registry, stable API, generated settings panel, vector pattern included
- Detachable widgets: the right-panel sections themselves float, collapse and re-dock
- AI-assisted creation (OpenRouter, DeepSeek) and native Recraft SVG
- Import SVG, SVGZ, PDF, Adobe Illustrator (.ai), EPS, images and video
- Multi-page PDF import: first page, a chosen page, or one artboard per page
- Multiple artboards: numbered badge on the canvas, panel, floating switcher, independent format, history per artboard
- Move an artboard on the workspace (drag its frame or its badge, X/Y fields, arrow keys) and delete it from the Document panel
- Per-artboard bleed (fond perdu) stored with the artboard, used as the export default
- Transform panel: X, Y, W, H and angle of the selection's bounding box, editable, artboard-relative coordinates
- Multiple documents, one tab per document (new-document dialog with presets), each with its own artboards and undo history
- Text inside a shape (wraps to the silhouette, row by row) or around a shape (text on path)
- Export SVG, vector PDF, multi-artboard PDF, PNG, JPG, WEBP (artboard, selection, chosen artboards, or all documents)
- PDF/X-1a export for printers: CMYK, gradients as real shadings, text as outlines, ICC profile
- Illustrator tools: outline stroke, offset path, simplify, symbols, blend
- Text to outlines (opentype.js), loadable fonts (.ttf/.otf)
- Versioned .plume project (JSON), autosave to localStorage/IndexedDB
- Incremental undo/redo: states shared per object, budget of 80 states or 64 MB

## Formats

- Import: .svg .svgz .pdf .ai .eps .plume .bird .json .png .jpg .webp .gif .bmp .avif .webm .mp4
- Export: .svg .pdf .png .jpg .webp .plume
- A modern .ai file (PDF-compatible) is imported as vectors through pdf.js.
- A PostScript .ai/.eps is interpreted by the Adobe Illustrator level 2 engine.

## Shortcuts

- V: select, P: pen, N: pencil, B: brush, I: eyedropper
- R: rectangle, E: ellipse, L: line, T: text, H: hand
- Space: temporary hand
- Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z: undo / redo
- Ctrl+D: duplicate, Alt+drag: duplicate while dragging
- Ctrl+Shift+G (or Ctrl+G): group, Ctrl+Shift+U: ungroup
- Ctrl+2 / Ctrl+3: lock / hide
- Ctrl+0: 100 %, Ctrl+Alt+0: fit to screen, Shift+2: zoom to selection
- Ctrl+R: rulers, Ctrl+' : grid, Ctrl+; : snapping
- Ctrl+K: plug-ins
- Ctrl+PageUp / Ctrl+PageDown: previous / next artboard
- Ctrl+Alt+PageUp / Ctrl+Alt+PageDown: previous / next document
- Ctrl+N / Ctrl+W: new document / close document
- Del: delete, Esc / Enter: finish a path

## API

- Bird.document.new(), Bird.document.open(file), Bird.document.payload()
- Bird.io.importSVG(text), Bird.io.importPDF(arrayBuffer), Bird.io.importEPS(arrayBuffer)
- Bird.export({ format, scope, background, scale, returnBlob })
- Bird.exportSVG({ background })
- Bird.io.pdfPageCount(buffer): page count and formats of a PDF
- Bird.export({ format:'pdf', scope:'pages' }): one PDF, one page per artboard
- Bird.export({ format:'pdf', scope:'pages', pages:'1, 3-5', documents:'all' }): artboard range, all documents
- BirdTextShape.create(shape, { mode:'inside'|'around', text, fontSize, padding })
- Bird.pages.list() / count() / go(n) / add(name) / duplicate() / remove(n) / rename(n, name) / move(n, delta)
- Bird.pages.moveOnWorkspace(x, y) / bleed(px): artboard position and bleed on the workspace
- Bird.pages.list() entries also carry x, y and bleed
- Bird.export({ format:'pdfx', scope:'document', returnBlob:true }): PDF/X-1a CMYK + ICC
- BirdVector.outlineStroke(obj) / offsetPathItem(item, d) / simplifyPath(obj, tol)
- BirdVector.vectorizeTextObject(canvas, obj) / loadFontFile(file)
- BirdVector.blendObjects(a, b, n) / createSymbol(obj, name) / instantiateSymbol(def, x, y)
- BirdPDFX.build({ width, height, bleed, background, items, images, icc, cmyk })
- Bird.view.rulers(bool), Bird.view.grid(bool), Bird.view.snap(bool)
- Bird.widgets.detach(name) / dock(name) / dockAll() / reset()
- Bird.document.undo() / redo() / history() / edit(fn, label): incremental history
- Bird.commands.run(id) / list() / groups(): registry shared by keyboard and native menu
- BirdPlugins.register(manifest), BirdPlugins.list(), BirdPlugins.toggle(id)
- BirdI18n.get() / set('en' or 'fr') / t(text): interface language, English by default

## Shortcuts (Illustrator / Figma)

Ctrl becomes Cmd on macOS. F1 shows the list generated from the registry.
File: Ctrl+N / Ctrl+O / Ctrl+S / Ctrl+Shift+S / Ctrl+Shift+P / Ctrl+E / Ctrl+P
Edit: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y / Ctrl+X / Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V / Ctrl+Shift+V / Ctrl+D / Ctrl+A / Ctrl+Shift+A
Object: Ctrl+Shift+G / Ctrl+Shift+U / Ctrl+] / Ctrl+[ / Ctrl+Shift+] / Ctrl+Shift+[ / Ctrl+2 / Ctrl+Alt+2 / Ctrl+3 / Ctrl+Alt+3 / Ctrl+Shift+O
View: Ctrl+0 / Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+Alt+0 / Ctrl+R / Ctrl+' / Ctrl+; / F11

## Plug-ins

A plug-in is a .plugin.js file that calls BirdPlugins.register() with a manifest
(id, name, version, ui.fields, run, preview). It receives an API: fabric, canvas, document,
selection(), add(), replaceSelection(), begin()/commit(), toast(), settings, svgToGroup().
Bundled plug-in: "Vector pattern" - stripes, checker, dots, waves, chevrons, triangles,
crosses, grid, scales. Output as a texture (a fabric.Pattern) or as real vector shapes.

## Interface language

The interface is English by default. French is available in Preferences (language
selector). The choice is stored in localStorage under `bird.lang`.

## Theme

Light and dark themes. The moon/sun button left of Preferences toggles them; the
choice is stored in localStorage under `bird.theme` and applied before first paint.
Every colour is a CSS custom property in `:root` (46 shades ordered by luminance,
`--n00` lightest to `--n45` darkest); `html[data-theme="dark"]` redefines only
those variables, so components invert themselves. Canvas-drawn parts (work area,
artboard frame, rulers) read `--canvas-*` and `--ruler-*` in JavaScript and repaint
on the `bird:theme` event. The artboard keeps its own colour: dark mode darkens the
surround, never the document.

## Builds

- / : standalone web build (no compilation)
- /astro/ : Astro build (SEO, PWA, API routes) - scripts generated from index.html
- /rust/ : Rust engine (CLI, local server, project conversion)
- /desktop/ : Tauri 2 shell -> macOS, Windows and Linux apps built by CI
  (system menu carrying the Adobe/Figma shortcuts, native files, .dmg/.msi/.deb/.AppImage)
